stories.title: Four children killed, four injured as van plunges into ravine in AJK's Neelum Valley
stories.brief: Four children from the same family were killed, and four others were injured when a van carrying them to a religious school plunged into a deep ravine in Azad Jammu and Kashmir's Neelum Valley on Saturday, police said. One of the injured children later died at the District Headquarters (DHQ) Hospital in Athmuqam, police confirmed.

stories.title: 4 children killed as van plunges into ravine in Neelum Valley
stories.brief: MUZAFFARABAD: Four children were killed and three other people were injured when a van carrying them to a madrasah plunged into a ravine in the upper reaches of Neelum Valley on Saturday, officials said.

stories.title: Oil spill washes up on UAE beaches after tanker strike
stories.brief: Satellite images show oil spreading for miles along the coastline, threatening local marine wildlife

stories.title: Punjab bans permanent police escorts for ministers, MPAs among others
stories.brief: Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz on Saturday directed that no permanent police squad be deployed with provincial ministers, members of the provincial assembly and other individuals.

stories.title: Pakistan rejects Afghan Taliban ‘diversionary allegations, demands action against TTP and BLA
stories.brief: The statement came a day after Afghan Taliban regime spokesperson Zabihullah Mujahid accused Pakistan’s security agencies of blaming Afghanistan for their failure to maintain security at home, allegedly to mislead the public.

stories.title: Jordan king orders 'iron fist' response to deadly church attack
stories.brief: Jordan's King Abdullah ordered security forces on ‌Saturday to respond with an "iron fist" as authorities searched for gunmen who opened fire and killed nine people during a church funeral service.

stories.title: PTI retains Junaid Akbar as K-P president, grants authority to Noorul Haq Qadri in his absence
stories.brief: According to a notification issued today and shared on X, Senator Noorul Haq Qadri, identified as the party’s senior vice-president in K-P, would preside over meetings of the provincial cabinet in the absence of Junaid.

stories.title: Pakistan denounces ‘heinous’ church attack in Jordan, reiterates condemnation of terrorism
stories.brief: Pakistan has strongly condemned the “heinous terrorist attack” on a funeral procession at a church in Jordan’s Karak Governorate, reiterating its condemnation of terrorism in all its forms and manifestations. Gunmen killed at least seven people and wounded dozens at a church in southern Jordan on Friday.

stories.title: Pakistan refutes former US envoy's 'unsubstantiated' allegations of arming Afghans to fight Taliban
stories.brief: The Ministry of Information on Saturday categorically rejected the baseless and misleading allegations by former US envoy to Afghanistan Zalmay Khalilzad of arming former Afghans to fight the Taliban and terrorist groups. "Pakistan categorically rejects the baseless and misleading allegations by Khalilzad of arming former Afghans to fight the Taliban and their supporter terrorist groups.

stories.title: Sindh govt forms JIT to investigate Mir Raza case, orders action against police officials
stories.brief: Separately, the Sindh government had initiated measures to implement the recommendations of the judicial inquiry commission that examined the circumstances surrounding Raza’s death and identified alleged shortcomings in the police investigation. Action against senior police officers The Sindh government had decided to communicate the judicial commission’s observations to DIG Amir Farooqi and DIG Farrukh Lanjar.

stories.title: Pakistan condemns 'heinous terrorist attack' on church in Jordan
stories.brief: Pakistan on Saturday strongly condemned "the heinous terrorist attack" at a funeral procession in a church in Jordan's Karak governorate, which resulted in "the loss of several precious lives, with many injured," the Foreign Office (FO) said in a statement.

stories.title: Fire engulfs Hitler's mountaintop Eagle's Nest retreat
stories.brief: Police in the southern German state of Bavaria have detained a 33-year-old German man following the fire.

stories.title: Amber weather warning as Storm Boelo hits Scotland
stories.brief: The Met Office has issued an amber warning for wind over Scotland from 21:00 until 21:00 on Sunday.

stories.title: Storm Boelo to bring severe gales and heavy rain into Sunday
stories.brief: An amber weather warning has been issued for much of Scotland, parts of Northern Ireland and northern England, as Storm Boelo approaches.

stories.title: Wales plans to ban steel pylons as government launches consultation
stories.brief: The Welsh government says it is consulting on an "undergrounding-first approach" to electricity lines.

stories.title: White House lifts tariffs on some Canadian goods as midterm elections loom
stories.brief: From 30 October, tariffs will be eased on some products, including certain machinery, and placed on others, such as carpets.

stories.title: How does the UK state pension compare with other countries?
stories.brief: Do British pensioners have it better or worse than those in other countries?

stories.title: UK to invest £100m in 'world first' AI Biosecurity Lab
stories.brief: The chancellor will unveil AI spending aimed at shoring up the UK's defences in Wednesday's Budget.

stories.title: What is PHP and why did it spark a global cyber-security scramble?
stories.brief: AI uncovered long-hidden programming flaws, triggering a rare global cyber-security response.
